title: The conversation reader on Home: a model reads the person's words, measured against the rules on a fourth sealed set
request: Three sealed sets in a row showed word rules gaining on each set's phrasings and meeting new ones on the next; now that Claude is configured, measure the conversation reader against the rules and judge it on a fourth sealed set.
spec: The reader reads the problem sentence and the answers that settle the card; every value quotes the person; a person's statement and the data come before it; off in the product until it passes its sealed measurement under a rule fixed before the run.
plan: Freeze a fourth sealed set first.
Wire the reader into Home behind a switch and its measurement.
Add the reader arm to the journeys command with a cap.
Measure live on dev and the three spent sets.
Review, fix, commit, gate, run the fourth set once.

decisions.decision: The reader's family weighs below what the card infers from the person's statements and the data.
decisions.why: A model reading is not the person's statement: a label file brought later still makes rare events.

decisions.decision: A sealed reader run with any failed request is not stored.
decisions.why: A run where the rules answered for the reader is not a reader arm.

decisions.decision: The product switch stays off until a stored sealed run shows the reader passed.
decisions.why: A role serves the product only after it measured better than the rules.

change: dclab_rnd/draft/reader.py (new), chat.py, card.py; dclab_core/prompts/conversation_reader.md and HASHES; models/settings.py may-see; journeys command (--reader, --yes, --cap-eur, --spent), GATE_V4 and reader_passed; tests conversation_reader_home (new) and journeys; HRN-003, an AEV result.

findings.defect: The reader read a review queue as ranking.
findings.scenario: Which deliveries to check first became a ranking of items.
findings.cause: The prompt did not tell cases to review from items shown to a person.

findings.defect: The reader's own yes or no blocked the data's long-text rule.
findings.scenario: A note triage answered yes or no became classification, not text.
findings.cause: A shape the model read was taken as a family said.
findings.fix: The reader's shape stays a shape; the card infers first without it.

findings.defect: The reader named an outcome column for a ranking.
findings.scenario: The Solution page refused the recommender's save.
findings.fix: No reader outcome for families that read no column.

findings.defect: A quarter of the reader's requests failed.
findings.scenario: Replies were cut at the token limit, and the rules answered for them.
findings.cause: The model reasons before its short JSON, and the limit was 300.
findings.fix: A limit of 1200; a failure counted and a run with one never stored.

findings.defect: The reader made a column mentioned as known later the outcome.
findings.scenario: We only know it once final_refund_amount is paid set the target.
findings.cause: The reader's branch skipped the clause check.
findings.fix: The clause holding the column is checked on every branch.

findings.defect: A family read in one answer replaced one stated earlier.
findings.scenario: A classification said, then rare events read from the outcome answer.
findings.cause: The reader's family was applied to any answer.
findings.fix: Only when asked for it or while the family is open.

findings.defect: An inferred family overrode a shape it contradicts.
findings.scenario: A yes or no for lateness became regression.
findings.cause: The inference was kept whatever it said.
findings.fix: Kept only when it is a family of that shape.

findings.defect: The reader's family was treated as the person's statement.
findings.scenario: A label file brought later no longer made the problem a rare event.
findings.cause: The card passed it as stated.
findings.fix: Inferred first; the reader names only what is open or a shape.

findings.defect: A sealed run could be stored without a clean reader arm or with no rule for comparing.
findings.scenario: A capped or failing reader would be stored as the reader arm and spend the set.
findings.cause: No failure count; no comparison fixed before the run.
findings.fix: Failures counted and refusing a store; the comparison in the gate; a sealed run needs both arms.

findings.defect: The reader's labels reading was paid for and dropped.
findings.scenario: A labels answer the rules could not read stayed unread.
findings.fix: Recorded where the rules read none.

findings.defect: What the reader may see no longer said the problem description.
findings.scenario: The Admin page told reviewers less than the model was sent.
findings.cause: The purpose's text was written before.

findings.defect: The product switch did not check the measurement.
findings.scenario: Setting the switch with a key would serve an unmeasured reader.
findings.fix: On only after a stored sealed pass.

measurements.name: the reader on dev material
measurements.gate: the reader right on at least as many people as the rules on each set
measurements.result: dev 15 and 15; the first set 24 and 24; the second 29 and 29; the third 29 against 25; after the limit was raised, 20 requests with none failed
measurements.against_gate: never fewer than the rules, more on the third set
limits: Dev material: the prompt was adjusted on these people.
Spend is an upper bound: dollars entered as euros.

measurements.name: the fourth sealed set, both arms run once
measurements.gate: the reader arm passes the suite bar alone, is right on at least as many people as the rules arm on the same people, and no reader request failed
measurements.result: rules 20 of 30; reader 25 of 30, interval 0.664 to 0.927; 64 reader requests, none failed; six people gained and one lost
measurements.against_gate: 25 of 30 is below the suite bar though above the rules, and no request failed

outcome: The reader beats the rules on a sealed set (25 against 20 of 30) but stays off: 25 is below the bar fixed before the run.
lessons: A reasoning model's short answer can need many output tokens: set the limit from a real reply.
A reading by a model is evidence, not the person's statement: put it after what they said and what the data shows.
risks: Live cost: about half a cent a request, with reasoning tokens billed.
